description: On the set of #HailMaryProject, author #AndyWeir explains to Adam Savage how he visualizes the things he writes about (or, more accurately, DOESN'T).
title: #HailMaryProject’s Author Had No Idea What Rocky Looked Like (Until the Movie)

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
During this visit to the props workshop of Project Hail Mary, Adam couldn't help but gravitate toward the paint department. Supervising props painter James Wickison shows Adam how his team developed the techniques for painting the hardware props aboard the Hail Mary as well as Rocky's xenonite models.
